aliases: スマートレンディング
summary: Smart Lending was a Japanese crypto-asset lending service whose first-party terms described unsecured consumption-loan contracts with fixed lending periods and stated annualized interest rates. The operator announced on 2026-09-02 that the official website and My Page would close on 2026-09-04.
what_happened: First-party materials had described 30-day ordinary and 365-day premium crypto lending and stated that ownership of lent crypto transferred to Smart Lending Co., Ltd., with lent assets outside statutory segregated management. On 2026-09-02 the operator announced a comprehensive review of future service policy and stated that the official website and My Page would close on 2026-09-04. This record therefore treats the service as operations ended from 2026-09-04 without inferring insolvency, customer loss or a withdrawal suspension that the notice does not establish.
uncertainty_notes: The exact original service-launch date remains unresolved. The closure notice establishes the website/My Page shutdown date but does not establish insolvency, customer loss, a claims process or universal repayment outcome. Advertised 11%/13% annualized rates, yield-source explanations and reserve/return-preparation statements remain operator claims.
notes: Promotion originally followed duplicate-clear candidate cya_candidate_000148 and candidate PR #339. Lifecycle status was corrected from active to operations_ended after the 2026-09-02 first-party closure notice. No GEMFOREX or IZAKA-YA affiliation is asserted.
